items: 2 · Search, see where an image is used
3 · Insert it and preview the page

steps.caption: Create a page: **New** › Page, name it, **Create**

steps.name: Media Library
steps.caption: Open **Panels** › **Media Library**: every image the site uses

steps.name: com-sun.jpg
steps.caption: Search, open an image: **References** lists the pages using it, then **Metadata**
**Insert** puts the same image on this page: no new upload
In **Layout** view the image shows as visitors will see it
The previewed page uses the existing image

steps.title: One image, reused across pages
items: Search by name, or doc:/path and folder:/path
References show every page that uses an image
Insert reuses the image instead of uploading a copy
